entries.dataset_name: ASGS Ed.3 SA1 to SAL allocation (official ABS allocation/correspondence file)
entries.licence_notes: CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International) — attribute the ABS
entries.notes: Resolved 2026-07-20 from the official ABS allocation files page: ABS publishes no direct SA1-level file for this pair. Official inputs are Mesh Block allocations: SAL_2021_AUST.xlsx (MB->target, page-listed size 19.5 MB) joined to MB_2021_AUST.xlsx (MB->SA1..STATE main structure, 33.69 MB). SA1-level pairs are derived by aggregating MB rows (ratio_basis mesh_block_count at staging; dwelling/population weights applied later at core per Sprint 2 plan). Requires the shared MB input asgs_mb_2021_allocation (MB_2021_AUST.xlsx) joined on MB_CODE_2021.
